description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app demonstrating borderless buttons in a list activity. It includes layout setup, event handlers for buttons and list items, and a menu linking to documentation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends ListActivity to display a list of items with borderless buttons. Handles button clicks to finish the activity and menu actions to open documentation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, adapter, and click handlers for cancel and OK buttons.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides views for each list item, inflating layout and setting click handlers for its internal buttons.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with entries from menu resource.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, opening documentation link in a browser.
